description: This file defines the interface 'IOmiProxy' within the 'omi' namespace, providing abstract methods to mount and unmount crypted bundles, and to register/unregister error listeners. It acts as a wrapper around an omi_dbus_api, simplifying method calls and signal handling for related operations.

classes.name: IOmiProxy
classes.description: Abstract interface class providing methods for managing crypted bundles and error listeners within the OMI proxy context.

methods.name: mountCryptedBundle
methods.description: Mounts a crypted bundle given container ID, filesystem image path, and config path. Outputs the decrypted config bundle path. Returns success status.

methods.name: umountCryptedBundle
methods.description: Unmounts the crypted bundle identified by the container ID. Returns success status.

methods.name: registerListener
methods.description: Registers an error listener callback, returns a listener ID or 0 on failure.

methods.name: unregisterListener
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered error listener identified by the listener ID.

ctags.name: OmiErrorListener
ctags.pattern: /^    typedef std::function<void(const std::string&, ErrorType, const void*)> OmiErrorListener;$/
